# Airplane

[← Switch](switch.md) · [All examples](../EXAMPLES.md) · [Chat heads →](chat_heads.md)

<img src="../gifs/airplane.gif" width="300" alt="Airplane">

Fly a plane by tilting the phone (or by dragging, where there is no motion sensor).

Reanimated docs: [device/useAnimatedSensor](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-reanimated/docs/device/useAnimatedSensor)

## What to look at

- Gravity readings set where you steer, and the plane follows on a spring.
- It banks in 3D (`rotateY`) by how far it lags behind where you steer.
- Three cloud layers scroll at different speeds from one `useFrameCallback`; climbing makes them faster.
- The contrail is a chain of springs, each chasing the one ahead.
- `tilt_mapping.dart` holds the tilt-to-steering maths, which `example_app/test/tilt_mapping_test.dart` checks against simulated device poses.

## Code

The screen comes first, then the components it uses. Shared helpers (`DemoPage`, `Section`, `Stage`, `Palette`, `Buttons`, `ChoiceChips`, `LabeledSlider`) live in `example_app/lib/src/common/` and only do layout.

### `lib/src/screens/airplane_screen.dart`

```dart
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

import '../common/common.dart';
import '../components/airplane_painter.dart';
import '../components/contrail_dot.dart';
import '../components/sky_cloud.dart';
import '../components/tilt_mapping.dart';

/// An airplane you fly by tilting the phone (useAnimatedSensor, gravity),
/// or by dragging where there is no sensor.
///
/// * The plane eases toward where you steer with a spring, and banks in 3D
///   into the turn by how far behind its target it is.
/// * Three cloud layers scroll at different speeds (useFrameCallback) for
///   depth; climbing toward the top of the screen flies faster.
/// * The contrail is a chain of springs, each chasing the one ahead.
/// * The ground shadow drifts with the bank.
class AirplaneScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const AirplaneScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<AirplaneScreen> createState() => _AirplaneScreenState();
}

class _AirplaneScreenState extends State<AirplaneScreen> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  static const planeWidth = 110.0;
  static const planeHeight = 121.0;
  static const trailLength = 9;
  static final random = math.Random(7);

  late final area = useSharedValue(const Size(390, 700));
  late final gravity = useAnimatedSensor(SensorType.gravity);

  /// Where you are steering, from -1 to 1 on each axis.
  late final steer = useSharedValue(const Offset(0, 0.4));

  /// Where the plane is, following [steer] on a spring.
  late final position = useDerivedAnimation(
    const Offset(0, 0.4),
    () => withSpring(steer.value, dampingRatio: 0.75, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 900)),
  );

  /// Bank angle: leaning into the turn by how far the plane lags its target.
  late final bank = useDerivedValue(() => clamp((steer.value.dx - position.value.dx) * 2.6, -1.1, 1.1));
  late final pitch = useDerivedValue(() => clamp((position.value.dy - steer.value.dy) * 1.2, -0.5, 0.5));

  /// Flying speed: faster near the top.
  late final speed = useDerivedValue(() => interpolate(position.value.dy, [-1, 1], [2.4, 0.7]));

  late final planeOrigin = useDerivedValue(() {
    final a = area.value;
    return Offset(
      (a.width - planeWidth) / 2 * (1 + position.value.dx * 0.85),
      (a.height - planeHeight) / 2 * (1 + position.value.dy * 0.8),
    );
  });

  late final planeStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(
        translateX: planeOrigin.value.dx,
        translateY: planeOrigin.value.dy,
        rotateY: bank.value,
        rotateX: pitch.value,
        rotate: bank.value * 0.45,
        perspective: 500,
      ));

  late final shadowStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(
        translateX: planeOrigin.value.dx + 30 + bank.value * 18,
        translateY: planeOrigin.value.dy + 46,
        scaleX: 0.75 * math.cos(bank.value),
        scaleY: 0.75,
      ));

  // Three cloud layers: far, middle and near. Farther layers move more
  // slowly, which is what gives the sky its depth.
  static const layerSpeeds = [30.0, 70.0, 140.0];
  late final layers = [for (final _ in layerSpeeds) useSharedValue(0.0)];
  late final clouds = [
    for (var layer = 0; layer < 3; layer++)
      for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++)
        (layer: layer, x: 0.15 + random.nextDouble() * 0.7, y: random.nextDouble(), width: [70.0, 110.0, 170.0][layer] * (0.8 + random.nextDouble() * 0.5)),
  ];

  /// The contrail: dot 0 chases the tail, each later dot the one before.
  late final List<SharedValue<Offset>> trail = _buildTrail();

  List<SharedValue<Offset>> _buildTrail() {
    final dots = <SharedValue<Offset>>[];
    for (var i = 0; i < trailLength; i++) {
      final ahead = i == 0 ? null : dots[i - 1];
      dots.add(useDerivedAnimation(
        planeOrigin.value + Offset(planeWidth / 2, planeHeight - 8 + i * 9.0),
        () {
          final target = ahead == null
              ? planeOrigin.value + const Offset(planeWidth / 2, planeHeight - 8)
              : ahead.value + Offset(0, 6 * speed.value);
          return withSpring(target, dampingRatio: 1, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 90));
        },
      ));
    }
    return dots;
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    useFrameCallback((frame) {
      final dt = (frame.timeSincePreviousFrame?.inMicroseconds ?? 0) / 1e6;
      for (var i = 0; i < layers.length; i++) {
        layers[i].value += layerSpeeds[i] * speed.value * dt;
      }
    });
    // Tilt to steer: rolling the phone moves the plane sideways, and tipping
    // the top of the phone away from you makes it climb.
    useAnimatedReaction(() => gravity.sensor.value, (g, _) {
      if (!gravity.isAvailable || dragging) return;
      steer.value = gravityToSteer(g);
    });
  }

  bool dragging = false;

  void onPan(DragUpdateDetails d) {
    final a = area.value;
    steer.value = Offset(
      clamp(steer.value.dx + d.delta.dx / (a.width / 2), -1, 1),
      clamp(steer.value.dy + d.delta.dy / (a.height / 2), -1, 1),
    );
  }

  Widget _cloud(({int layer, double x, double y, double width}) c) => Positioned(
        left: 0,
        top: 0,
        child: SkyCloud(
          scroll: layers[c.layer],
          area: area,
          x: c.x,
          y: c.y,
          width: c.width,
          opacity: [0.45, 0.7, 0.85][c.layer],
        ),
      );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Airplane')),
      body: LayoutBuilder(builder: (context, constraints) {
        // Explicit sizes: a Stack of positioned children collapses without one.
        final size = Size(constraints.maxWidth, constraints.maxHeight);
        return GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onPanStart: (_) => dragging = true,
        onPanUpdate: onPan,
        onPanEnd: (_) => dragging = false,
        child: AnimatedView(
          onLayout: (s) => area.value = s,
          child: Container(
            width: size.width,
            height: size.height,
            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
              gradient: LinearGradient(
                begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                colors: [Color(0xFF3D7BE0), Color(0xFF7FB8F5), Color(0xFFCFE6FB)],
              ),
            ),
            child: Stack(
              children: [
                SizedBox(width: size.width, height: size.height),
                for (final c in clouds.where((c) => c.layer < 2)) _cloud(c),
                Positioned(
                  left: 0,
                  top: 0,
                  child: AnimatedView(
                    style: shadowStyle,
                    child: const CustomPaint(
                      size: Size(planeWidth, planeHeight),
                      painter: AirplanePainter(shadow: true),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                for (var i = 0; i < trailLength; i++)
                  Positioned(left: 0, top: 0, child: ContrailDot(position: trail[i], index: i, length: trailLength)),
                Positioned(
                  left: 0,
                  top: 0,
                  child: AnimatedView(
                    style: planeStyle,
                    child: const CustomPaint(
                      size: Size(planeWidth, planeHeight),
                      painter: AirplanePainter(),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                // The near layer passes over the plane.
                for (final c in clouds.where((c) => c.layer == 2)) _cloud(c),
                Positioned(
                  left: 16,
                  right: 16,
                  bottom: 24,
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(color: const Color(0x66001A72), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
                    child: Text(
                      gravity.isAvailable
                          ? 'Tilt to steer · tip the top away to climb and speed up'
                          : 'No motion sensor here: drag anywhere to steer',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: const TextStyle(color: Palette.grey),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
      }),
    );
  }
}
```

### `lib/src/components/airplane_painter.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';

/// A jet seen from above, nose up, drawn to fill [Size]. With [shadow] it
/// paints a flat translucent silhouette for the ground shadow.
class AirplanePainter extends CustomPainter {
  const AirplanePainter({this.shadow = false});

  final bool shadow;

  // The outline in a 100 × 110 box (x from -50 to 50, y from -55 to 55).
  static const _outline = [
    Offset(0, -55), Offset(6, -44), Offset(7, -14), Offset(50, 8), Offset(50, 15),
    Offset(7, 6), Offset(5, 34), Offset(18, 44), Offset(18, 49), Offset(2, 45),
    Offset(0, 50), Offset(-2, 45), Offset(-18, 49), Offset(-18, 44), Offset(-5, 34),
    Offset(-7, 6), Offset(-50, 15), Offset(-50, 8), Offset(-7, -14), Offset(-6, -44),
  ];

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final sx = size.width / 100, sy = size.height / 110;
    Offset map(Offset p) => Offset((p.dx + 50) * sx, (p.dy + 55) * sy);

    final body = Path()..moveTo(map(_outline.first).dx, map(_outline.first).dy);
    for (final p in _outline.skip(1)) {
      final q = map(p);
      body.lineTo(q.dx, q.dy);
    }
    body.close();

    if (shadow) {
      canvas.drawPath(body, Paint()..color = const Color(0x33001A72));
      return;
    }
    canvas.drawPath(body, Paint()..color = const Color(0xFFF8F9FF));
    canvas.drawPath(
      body,
      Paint()
        ..color = const Color(0xFF001A72)
        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
        ..strokeWidth = 1.5,
    );
    // Cockpit and engine pods.
    canvas.drawCircle(map(const Offset(0, -38)), 3.2 * sx, Paint()..color = const Color(0xFF5B8DEF));
    for (final x in [-24.0, 24.0]) {
      canvas.drawCircle(map(Offset(x, 6)), 3 * sx, Paint()..color = const Color(0xFFB58DF1));
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(AirplanePainter oldDelegate) => oldDelegate.shadow != shadow;
}
```

### `lib/src/components/contrail_dot.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

/// One puff of the contrail, smaller and fainter toward the end.
class ContrailDot extends StatefulWidget {
  const ContrailDot({super.key, required this.position, required this.index, required this.length});
  final SharedValue<Offset> position;
  final int index;
  final int length;

  @override
  State<ContrailDot> createState() => _ContrailDotState();
}

class _ContrailDotState extends State<ContrailDot> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  double get _size => 12 - 7 * widget.index / widget.length;

  late final style = useAnimatedStyle(() => AnimatedStyle(
        translateX: widget.position.value.dx - _size / 2,
        translateY: widget.position.value.dy,
        opacity: 0.75 * (1 - widget.index / widget.length),
      ));

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedView(
        style: Styles([
          AnimatedStyle(width: _size, height: _size, borderRadius: _size / 2, backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFFFFFFF)),
          style,
        ]),
      );
}
```

### `lib/src/components/sky_cloud.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

/// One cloud of a parallax layer. It sits at [x] across the sky and moves
/// down with its layer's [scroll], wrapping round once it leaves the bottom.
class SkyCloud extends StatefulWidget {
  const SkyCloud({
    super.key,
    required this.scroll,
    required this.area,
    required this.x,
    required this.y,
    required this.width,
    required this.opacity,
  });

  /// Pixels the layer has scrolled.
  final SharedValue<double> scroll;
  final SharedValue<Size> area;

  /// Position as fractions of the sky's width and height.
  final double x;
  final double y;
  final double width;
  final double opacity;

  @override
  State<SkyCloud> createState() => _SkyCloudState();
}

class _SkyCloudState extends State<SkyCloud> with ReanimatedStateMixin {
  late final style = useAnimatedStyle(() {
    final area = widget.area.value;
    final span = area.height + 200;
    final y = (widget.y * span + widget.scroll.value) % span - 120;
    return AnimatedStyle(translateX: widget.x * area.width - widget.width / 2, translateY: y);
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final h = widget.width * 0.42;
    Widget puff(double size) => Container(
          width: size,
          height: size,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(color: const Color(0xFFFFFFFF), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(size / 2)),
        );
    return AnimatedView(
      style: Styles([AnimatedStyle(opacity: widget.opacity), style]),
      child: SizedBox(
        width: widget.width,
        height: h,
        child: Stack(children: [
          SizedBox(width: widget.width, height: h),
          Positioned(left: 0, top: h * 0.35, child: puff(h * 0.65)),
          Positioned(left: widget.width * 0.22, top: 0, child: puff(h)),
          Positioned(left: widget.width * 0.5, top: h * 0.15, child: puff(h * 0.85)),
          Positioned(
            left: h * 0.3,
            top: h * 0.55,
            child: Container(
              width: widget.width - h * 0.5,
              height: h * 0.45,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(color: const Color(0xFFFFFFFF), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(h * 0.22)),
            ),
          ),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

### `lib/src/components/tilt_mapping.dart`

```dart
import 'package:dartnative/dartnative.dart';
import 'package:reanimated_dartnative/reanimated_dartnative.dart';

// How the examples turn a gravity reading into motion. Readings use the
// plugin's axes on both platforms: x toward the device's right edge, y
// toward its top edge, and the value is the force holding the device up
// (flat, screen up: z = +9.81; right edge down: x < 0; upright: y = +9.81).
// test/tilt_mapping_test.dart checks these against simulated device poses.

/// How far the useAnimatedSensor box slides: toward whichever edge is
/// lower, as the docs example's `gravity.x * 20` (with the screen's y axis
/// pointing down), limited to [maxDistance].
Offset gravityToBoxOffset(Value3D g, {double maxDistance = 100}) => Offset(
      clamp(-g.x * 20, -maxDistance, maxDistance),
      clamp(g.y * 20, -maxDistance, maxDistance),
    );

/// The airplane's steering, from -1 to 1 on each axis: rolling right steers
/// right, and tipping the top of the device away from you (from upright
/// toward flat) climbs toward the top of the screen.
Offset gravityToSteer(Value3D g) => Offset(
      clamp(-g.x / 4.5, -1, 1),
      clamp((g.y - 5) / 4, -1, 1),
    );
```
